visualCharacteristics.purpose: Sticky article table of contents linking to the article's H2 sections
visualCharacteristics.description: White card (36px padding, 6px radius, two-layer shadow) with an uppercase 18px heading and a vertical list of 20px blue links on a 3px #e5e5e5 left rail; the active section is navy with an orange (#dd6814) rail segment.

contentPattern.description: Optional heading only; the list is generated from the page's default-content H2s
contentPattern.structure: single row, single cell: heading text (optional, defaults to 'Table of contents')

usage.description: Left sidebar (aside) of blog/insight articles, beside the article body.

reuseGuidance: Place once per article. Only H2s in default content are listed (H2s inside blocks are skipped); missing ids are generated from the heading text. Sticky from 900px when its section column is taller than the card.
